summary: Fixed a bug where enabling music crossfade broke auto-advance to the next track after the first one finished.
details: The crossfade timer's early completion signal was reusing the same suppression flag stop()/skip() use, which incorrectly swallowed the genuine final completion signal the first time any crossfade fired -- so playback silently stopped after one track instead of continuing to the next.
/music skip now also crossfades into the next track (or performs an instant cut if crossfade_seconds is 0), instead of always hard-cutting.
